Card Q&A.q: I used this card's [On Play] effect to return 1 card from my security stack to the hand, then I placed 1 yellow card with the [Vaccine] trait from my hand at the bottom of my security stack. At such times, is a card considered to be added to my security stack, allowing this card's [Your Turn] effect to activate?

Card Q&A.a: No, there are no requirements for the card you return to your hand with this effect, so you don't have to reveal it to your opponent.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's [On Play] effect to return 1 card from my security stack to the hand, do I have to reveal the returned card to my opponent?

Effect: [On Play] By returning the top card of your security stack to the hand, you may place 1 yellow card with the [Vaccine] trait from your hand at the bottom of your security stack.
[Your Turn] When a card is added to your security stack, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
